requirement: An import blocked by Cloudflare says what to switch off in the Cloudflare dashboard, with folded steps, instead of the manual-install sentence; every other firewall keeps the shared sentence

oracle.ref: PR #1527 (fix); fix evidence: Production: after a manual install of Claude Cowork on a site behind Cloudflare, the engine door still answered 403 cf-mitigated: challenge ('Just a moment...'), so the shared sentence's 'install Claude Cowork yourself' could not help
oracle.invariant: S1: with cloudflare the alert starts with import_error_blocked_by_cloudflare and does not contain 'install Claude Cowork yourself'; the three steps and the skip-rule note are absent until 'How to do it' is pressed, then present, with three li under [data-cloudflare-steps]. Every other case shows exactly import_error_blocked_by_firewall, no 'How to do it' button and no [data-cloudflare-steps]. failedRunDetail keeps firewall 'cloudflare' and drops the unknown string and the number. S2: cloudflare maps to import_error_blocked_by_cloudflare on every platform; every other firewall and none map to import_error_blocked_by_firewall; install_failed keeps import_error_install_failed. S3: the inline red line under the address shows exactly import_error_blocked_by_cloudflare and no [data-cloudflare-steps] anywhere on the page.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
